cards.example_en: Hot food was waiting when we came in from the rain.
cards.example_zh: 我们淋雨回来时，热饭已经摆好了。

cards.example_en: I dropped my fork under the table during lunch.
cards.example_zh: 午饭时我的叉子掉到了桌子底下。

cards.example_en: Ripe fruit from the market filled two large bowls.
cards.example_zh: 从市场买来的熟水果装满了两个大碗。

cards.example_en: The truck could not leave because its fuel had run out.
cards.example_zh: 卡车开不走了，因为它的燃料已经用完。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：玻璃；杯子
cards.example_en: He knocked over a glass of juice at breakfast.
cards.example_zh: 早饭时他打翻了一杯果汁。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：神（名词）
cards.example_en: In that myth, a god sends rain to the dry valley.
cards.example_zh: 在那个神话里，一位神把雨送到干旱的山谷。

cards.example_en: We visited Hong Kong during the summer holiday.
cards.example_zh: 我们在暑假期间访问了香港。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：饥饿的
cards.example_en: I felt hungry after the long football match.
cards.example_zh: 踢完那场很长的足球赛后，我感到很饿。

cards.example_en: The puddle grew an inch deeper after the noon storm.
cards.example_zh: 中午的暴风雨过后，水坑又深了一英寸。

cards.example_en: Apple juice stained the white cloth on the picnic table.
cards.example_zh: 苹果汁弄脏了野餐桌上的白桌布。

cards.example_en: Use this knife to slice the apples for the fruit salad.
cards.example_zh: 用这把刀把苹果切成片，做水果沙拉。

cards.example_en: Her leadership kept the team calm during the close final.
cards.example_zh: 比分接近的决赛里，她的领导让全队保持冷静。

cards.example_en: The hungry dog will lick the empty rice bowl.
cards.example_zh: 那只饿狗会去舔空饭碗。

cards.example_en: Students log their running times in a sports notebook.
cards.example_zh: 学生们把每次跑步的时间记在运动笔记本上。

cards.example_en: We shared lunch on the grass behind the science block.
cards.example_zh: 我们在科学楼后面的草地上一起吃了午餐。
